decision.rationale: Promoted bounded 3D batching of existing exact 9/7 scale/lift stages for structurally compatible distinct-image groups. Both output modes improve for B16 at 128x128, 640x480 and 1024x1024; B1 retains the original per-image path and has no material regression. Reconstruction stages with output >20 MiB also retain the per-image path, avoiding the unbounded 1024x1024 regression recorded separately. Baseline and treatment used the same release-bench binary (SHA-256 5a93203b83bbf52fc962b6727a72fec1cb4ad5a1419cf2592798bc4f364560d6). Only the temporary disable-batching environment switch differed; it was removed afterward. Criterion extended some 20-sample collection windows beyond the requested five seconds. Timings cover warm prepared decode; parsing, preparation and initial upload are excluded. Corpus uses 16 patterned RGB8 inputs differing in the first pixel; encoded uniqueness and every decoded output are verified. The matrix is limited to one M4 Pro and this synthetic corpus. Concurrent unrelated working-tree edits to encode statistics are preserved and do not change between comparison arms. Commands and correctness limitations are in P20-metal-optimization-notes.md.
